title: Capture a thought and turn it into a task
goal: You had an idea you do not want to lose. Get it into the system, then turn it into a real task on the board that an agent could pick up.
steps: Find somewhere to write the raw thought down without filling in a form
See the captured thought listed where it was saved
Turn that captured thought into a task
Find the new task on the board, with the thought's wording still recognisable
